summary: Full e2e test of SUBSTRATE. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass (analyze/status/result/file-preview, exact data contract for files/edges/snapshots/meta, path traversal, 400/404/409 handling, cache re-submit, TypeScript repo pmndrs/drei). Frontend: landing page, validation, progress stages with real numbers, city reveal, building hover/click + code preview, time scrubber (drag/click + playback back to present day), new-repo return, error flow, /privacy and /terms all work with zero console/page errors. No functional bugs found; only low-contrast text design nits.

minor.issue: snapshot commit_date values are git AUTHOR dates and are not strictly monotonic (e.g. flask index 54: 2025-06-08 followed by 2025-05-17). Timeline scrubbing can appear to jump backwards. Consider using committer date (%cI) for bucketing/labels. Test relaxed to allow <=10% inversions.

issues: Hint text 'Drag to orbit. Scroll to approach. Hover a building.' (top-right) is near-invisible: light warm grey on light sky gradient, well below WCAG AA
Stage list text is low contrast on the tan ground/city background; during the transition it also renders over buildings making several lines hard to read
Error line 'git clone failed: ...' uses a muted red on tan — low contrast
Section eyebrow 'TIME', footer repo input placeholder and the hint line under it sit directly over the top-down 3D city; text/placeholder legibility is poor (no scrim/backdrop)

action_items: Optional: raise contrast of the city HUD hint text and progress-stage text (add scrim or darker foreground)
Optional: use committer dates for snapshot bucketing so the timeline is strictly chronological
Optional: add a translucent backdrop behind the landing 'Time' section copy/footer input so it reads over the 3D city
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: file_preview traversal guard uses `repo_dir not in target.parents` which correctly rejects ../ and absolute paths (verified with 4 payloads) - good.

server.py: in-memory `jobs` dict grows unbounded per process and Mongo cache depends on the on-disk clone still existing (WORK_DIR check); after /tmp cleanup a cached Mongo doc with a missing clone falls through to a new job (handled), but file preview for older jobs returns 404 'clone expired' - acceptable but worth surfacing in UI.
history.py build_history relies on `commits` being ordered by git log then reversed; author-date non-monotonicity leaks into snapshot dates (see minor backend issue).
seed_data_creation: None. Analyses created for pallets/flask, pmndrs/drei and one failing clone (thisuser/doesnotexist-xyz-123) in Mongo `analyses`.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; session fixture flask_job reuses cached analysis so full run is ~4s when warm). Frontend: hover works reliably at viewport 1920x800 by mouse.move sweep x=700..1300 at y=380 (first hit at 700,380 = src/flask/ctx.py). Building hover shows the info card with 'Click the building to read the file'; clicking loads code-preview (121 numbered lines). Scrub track testid scrub-track, click position offsets work; playback advances ~1 snapshot/0.6s and wraps to 'PRESENT DAY'. django/django (capped 1500) was NOT tested.
